newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps cuts Best Buy ratings.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps cuts Best Buy ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it downgraded Best Buy Co Inc's $150 million of senior subordinated notes to double-B from triple-B-minus and about $22 million of subordinated notes to double-B from double-B-plus.
Duff said it also downgraded $230 million of convertible monthly income preferred securities of Best Buy Capital LP to single-B-plus from double-B.
Duff said over the past couple of years Best Buy experienced a greater deterioration in credit protection measures and declining profit margins than anticipated.

"These financial pressures combined with rising business risk, largely reflecting the rapid changes that have occurred in the personal computer industry, are the key factors leading to the downgrade," Duff sid.
It added that revenues and earnings will be affected by ongoing personal computer industry problems including expanding outlets and pricing pressure.

It noted that Best Buy has altered its business plan, slowing expansion and concentrating on improving profitabilty. But a return to higher levels of profitability and debt protection measures may take some time, Duff said.
